description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_FarmingMilestone" name="Farming milestone reached"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Player" name="Player" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Send materials to selected friends" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ListUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseSharing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ProcessComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SetbackApplied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_MilestoneReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NoSharing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Create a farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IdentifyResources" name="Identify desired resources"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define resource and tool dependencies">
      <bpmn:documentation>Define custom game logic for dependencies, including resources required to create tools needed to gather other resources.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectResources" name="Collect selected resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Collect selected resources in parallel, with no more than 10 resource collections running concurrently.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(numberOfSelectedResources, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_CollectResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Disaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterStrikes</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply farming setback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SetbackApplied" name="Farming setback applied"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateList" name="Player requests a farming-list update" attachedToRef="Task_CollectResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">playerRequestsFarmingMaterialListUpdate</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdated" name="Farming-material list updated"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestoneReached" name="Farming milestone reached">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_FarmingMilestone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming" name="Bot finished farming"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose post-farming actions and selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingSplit" name="Choose sharing actions" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NoSharing" name="Continue without sharing"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingJoin" name="Complete selected actions" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessComplete" name="Farming process complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_IdentifyResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Priorities" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_Dependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_Collect" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_CollectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Milestone" sourceRef="Task_CollectResources" targetRef="Event_MilestoneReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Event_MilestoneReached" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_FarmingEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Setback" sourceRef="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_End" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_SetbackApplied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Task" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_ChooseSharing" sourceRef="EndEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseSharing_Split" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_SharingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">materialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSharing" name="Neither action selected" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Task_NoSharing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not bragSelected and not materialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSharing_Join" sourceRef="Task_NoSharing" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
